canonicalization.name: PocketWorld restricted JSON codepoints v1 (NOT RFC8785 JCS)

semanticDigest.algorithm: SHA-256 over canonical full request excluding only nonSemanticFields

stableIds.reason: Updating an app/profile must never reset original source/allocation/share spend identities. The namespace algorithms below remain fixed.

signatures.identity: P-256 SubjectPublicKeyInfo SHA-256 identity; exact certificate DER pin
signatures.encoding: canonical DER positive minimal r/s within exact secp256r1 order

delegation.sourceTargetShares: A original reservation signs frozen non-overlapping B/C/D exact-target/resource shares; sums cannot exceed the source hold; independent receiver owner grant remains mandatory
delegation.targetScope: Required closed targetResources[{targetDeviceId,resourceBinding}] in B forwardingScope and A DelegationProof; no independent target/resource arrays and no Cartesian expansion. Every forward targetShare must belong to both exact-pair scopes.

storedHistory.missingDurableAudience: local-only; never infer or manufacture authority
storedHistory.freshQuery: new direct native fixed-result query, original action identity only from accepted SQL audience
storedHistory.crossEpoch: old handles fail; fresh same-grant current epoch needs explicit current owner historyRead; no implicit grantId/deviceId migration

framing: uint32BE (binary flag high bit); binary=UUID16+uint64BE offset+SHA25632+raw<=262144; separate control/bulk exact-pin mTLS lanes

pairingRecovery.binding: Existing native CSPRNG one-use inviteId/tokenDigest, both complete DeviceId/instance/certificate pins and platform TLS CertificateVerify bind a unique fixed transcript; no additional nonce roundtrip.
pairingRecovery.commit: One ORIGINAL SQL transaction CASes invitation state/TTL and native confirmation revision/exact scope, stores peer+grant+the complete immutable PairingCompletion in the original invite receipt_json.
pairingRecovery.proof: PairingCommitReceipt uses the standard P256 signed-record format; binds commitId, committedAt, original invite, transcriptDigest, exact receiving grantDigest/grantId/epoch and both complete identities. grantDigest omits only the separately fenced revoked flag.
pairingRecovery.recovery: PairingFinalize purpose=commit|recover; committed recovery is a distinct native 1..30000ms read-only exact-pin mTLS handle. It never extends pending TTL, changes scopes/epochs/expiry, refills budget or dispatches business effects. Replies reuse exact originally stored completion bytes/signatures.
pairingRecovery.joinerReview: Original candidate record_json role=local_offer stores only native owner-reviewed public offer, local signature and exact local scope, never token. A native RecoveryOffer restores only this original review and requires proof of the prior in-TTL remote commit before reciprocal installation.
pairingRecovery.revocation: Current owner revoke, epoch/scope revision, pin/instance change or grant expiry explicitly denies remote executable recovery. Historical immutable commit remains local only and cannot restore active trust.
pairingRecovery.schemaMigration: No new table, column, database, Runner or version; state-specific records reuse original invite receipt_json and candidate record_json.

phoneTaskInputs.authority: existing native receiving-owner grant and exact current task/run/executorEpoch/allocation/controlLease; no external approval
phoneTaskInputs.resume: request review at expectedRevision, original phone owner confirms reviewRevision; no new task/run/grant
phoneTaskInputs.unknown: query original operation only; never rewrite or replay original wire

desktopViewer.authority: direct current receiving-owner grant; retained native owner page; no fabricated Agent task or run
desktopViewer.effect: write; one original single-use outbound operation per request; unknown input is never replayed
desktopViewer.control: original resource lease and fence; foreign human has no exposed lease; needsReconcile blocks take/input and survives release/close; AI requires fresh observation after human control
desktopViewer.media: receive-only video; frame metadata channel only; no input over RTC data channel
desktopViewer.budget: human input consumes original receiving grant lifetime tool pool in the atomic one-use operation claim; duplicate never double-spends and unknown never refunds
desktopViewer.frameDelivery: actual emitted uint32 RTP timestamp from the pinned sender packet path must equal the current decoded frame; missing or changed evidence is view-only
